metadata.name: pawket
metadata.description: A companion whose care is its record

instructions.name: adopt_pet
docs: A new pet at 72 across the board. The owner signs for the name; `payer` covers rent and
may be the owner or a sponsor.

instructions.name: adopt_pet_by_device
docs: Adoption signed by the owner's linked device: the pet is the owner's, at the owner's address.

instructions.name: buy
docs: Buy one thing in the Market at its fixed price, paid by the owner straight into Pawket's
treasury; the owner's Closet records it for good. `payer` covers the Closet's rent the first
time — the owner, or a sponsor.

accounts.name: closet
docs: Made the owner's in `buy` when it is new; one that is there already is held to them here.

instructions.name: buy_with_wallet
docs: An owner-approved purchase from Pawket Wallet into the fixed treasury.
The balance never reaches into rent; the sponsor may pay the Closet's rent.

accounts.name: closet
docs: Made the owner's in `buy` when it is new; one that is there already is held to them here.

instructions.name: care_by_device
docs: A care, signed by the owner's linked device: the same rules and the same record as one the
owner signs.

instructions.name: check_in
docs: At the event — from fifteen minutes before it starts until it ends — a pet that said it was
going, and is still in the guild, checks in, once.

accounts.name: member
docs: A pet checks in only while it is still in the event's guild.

instructions.name: check_in_by_device
docs: A check-in signed by the owner's linked device.

instructions.name: close_wallet
docs: The Pawket Wallet closes: its balance goes to its owner, its rent to whoever paid it. A
device is unlinked first, so nothing is left behind on one.

instructions.name: create_event
docs: While the founding pet is in the guild, its founder plans an event: a title, a line about it,
when it starts and ends. `id` is the founder's to choose (the app uses the start time), so a
guild's events need no counter.

accounts.name: founder_member
docs: The founding pet's place in the guild: a founder plans and asks only while it is there.

instructions.name: create_event_by_device
docs: An event planned by the founder's linked device.

instructions.name: create_poll
docs: While the founding pet is in the guild, its founder asks the guild something: two to four
options, open from ten minutes to fourteen days. Each wallet with a pet in the guild answers
once; no weight, no token.

instructions.name: create_poll_by_device
docs: A poll opened by the founder's linked device.

instructions.name: deposit
docs: `amount` lamports from the owner's own wallet into their Pawket Wallet.

instructions.name: dress
docs: Put something on, or take it off with 0. Looks only: nothing else on the pet changes.

instructions.name: dress_by_device
docs: Dressing, signed by the owner's linked device.

instructions.name: dress_owned
docs: Put on anything the owner may wear: one of the three starters, or a Market piece their Closet
holds. 0 takes it off. Looks only, like `dress`.

instructions.name: dress_owned_by_device
docs: `dress_owned`, signed by the owner's linked device.

instructions.name: finish_round
docs: A finished playground round. The first of a UTC day adds 25 XP; every one counts as a play
and as showing up. Vitals and cooldowns stay where they are.

instructions.name: finish_round_by_device
docs: A finished round, signed by the owner's linked device.

instructions.name: found_guild
docs: A pet founds a guild and is its first member. The slug is the guild's address, so a name is
one guild, and none of `RESERVED_SLUGS`; `payer` covers the rent of both accounts.

instructions.name: found_guild_by_device
docs: A founding signed by the owner's linked device.

instructions.name: fund_wallet_spend
docs: Fund a transaction from Pawket Wallet. The owner's existing SOL must remain untouched;
settlement is the final instruction in this same atomic transaction. Only the owner signs.

instructions.name: join_guild
docs: A pet joins a guild. A pet is in one guild at most: its member account is seeded by the pet.

instructions.name: join_guild_by_device
docs: A join signed by the owner's linked device.

instructions.name: leave_guild
docs: A pet leaves its guild. The member account closes and its rent goes back to whoever paid it.
The guild stays, with one fewer; a guild with nobody in it is still on the record.

instructions.name: leave_guild_by_device
docs: Leaving, signed by the owner's linked device. The rent still goes back to whoever paid it.

instructions.name: link_device
docs: Link `device` to act for the owner until `expires_at` (30 days at most), at most
`daily_actions` times a UTC day: it may do for the owner's pets what the owner signs for —
care, rounds, clothes, adoption, guilds, gatherings, waves — and nothing that moves money.
The device signs too, so only a key that is really there is linked, and it is handed its fee
float from the balance when the balance holds one. One device at a time: linking one
replaces the last.

accounts.name: device
docs: The device's own key, which signs to show it is really there, and is handed its float.

instructions.name: open_wallet
docs: The owner's Pawket Wallet: a balance only they can fill or empty, and room for one linked
device. `payer` covers its rent, and gets it back when the wallet closes.

instructions.name: perform_care_action
docs: Feed, play, groom or rest: decay to now, apply the locked deltas, +10 XP, then write the
Passport. Each action waits 30 minutes after its last use.

instructions.name: rsvp
docs: A pet in the guild is going to its event. One RSVP per pet per event, until it ends.

instructions.name: rsvp_by_device
docs: An RSVP signed by the owner's linked device.

instructions.name: settle_wallet_spend
docs: Return unspent SOL and sale proceeds to Pawket Wallet. If any existing owner SOL would be
consumed, the whole transaction fails, including the external trade.

instructions.name: unlink_device
docs: The device stops acting for the owner. The owner or the device itself may say so; when the
device signs, whatever it holds comes back to the balance.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The owner, or the device itself.

instructions.name: vote
docs: A wallet with a pet in the guild answers its poll: one ballot per wallet, before it closes.

instructions.name: vote_by_device
docs: A ballot cast by the owner's linked device: still one per wallet, the owner's.

instructions.name: wave
docs: Anyone but its owner waves at a pet, once a UTC day. Its guestbook counts every wave and
keeps the last eight visitors. A wave changes nothing about the pet.

accounts.name: guestbook
docs: Made the pet's in `greet` when it is new; one that is there already is held to it here.

instructions.name: wave_by_device
docs: A wave from the visitor's linked device: the visitor is the device's owner.

accounts.name: guestbook
docs: Made the pet's in `greet` when it is new; one that is there already is held to it here.

instructions.name: withdraw
docs: `amount` lamports from the Pawket Wallet back to its owner — only ever to its owner, and
never into the rent that keeps the account alive.

errors.name: InvalidPetName
errors.msg: A pet's name is 2 to 24 UTF-8 bytes.

errors.name: NotPetOwner
errors.msg: Only the pet's owner can do that.

errors.name: CareCooldownActive
errors.msg: That care is cooling down.

errors.name: UnknownWearable
errors.msg: There is nothing like that to wear.

errors.name: InvalidGuildSlug
errors.msg: A guild's address is 3 to 24 of a-z, 0-9 and inner hyphens.

errors.name: InvalidGuildName
errors.msg: A guild's name is 3 to 32 UTF-8 bytes.

errors.name: InvalidGuildMotto
errors.msg: A guild's motto is at most 80 UTF-8 bytes.

errors.name: UnknownCrest
errors.msg: There is no crest like that.

errors.name: InvalidAmount
errors.msg: An amount is more than nothing.

errors.name: InsufficientBalance
errors.msg: The Pawket Wallet does not hold that much.

errors.name: InvalidDeviceLink
errors.msg: A device is linked for up to 30 days and up to 500 actions a day, and is not the owner.

errors.name: NotThisDevice
errors.msg: That device is not the one linked to this Pawket Wallet.

errors.name: DeviceExpired
errors.msg: This device's link has run out. Link it again.

errors.name: DailyLimitReached
errors.msg: This device has done all it may today.

errors.name: NoDeviceLinked
errors.msg: No device is linked to this Pawket Wallet.

errors.name: DeviceStillLinked
errors.msg: Unlink the device before closing the Pawket Wallet.

errors.name: UnknownItem
errors.msg: The Market sells nothing like that.

errors.name: AlreadyOwned
errors.msg: Your closet holds that already.

errors.name: NotInCloset
errors.msg: That piece is not in your closet.

errors.name: InvalidEvent
errors.msg: An event has a 3 to 48 byte title, ends after it starts and after now, runs at most 7 days, and starts within 60.

errors.name: NotGuildFounder
errors.msg: Only the guild's founder can do that.

errors.name: NotInGuild
errors.msg: That pet is not in this guild.

errors.name: EventOver
errors.msg: That event is over.

errors.name: NotCheckInTime
errors.msg: Check-in opens 15 minutes before the event and closes when it ends.

errors.name: AlreadyCheckedIn
errors.msg: That pet has checked in already.

errors.name: InvalidPoll
errors.msg: A poll asks 3 to 80 bytes, offers 2 to 4 options of 1 to 24, and stays open 10 minutes to 14 days.

errors.name: PollClosed
errors.msg: That poll is closed.

errors.name: UnknownOption
errors.msg: That poll has no such option.

errors.name: CannotWaveAtOwnPet
errors.msg: Wave at someone else's pet.

errors.name: AlreadyWavedToday
errors.msg: You waved at this pet today already.

errors.name: ReservedGuildSlug
errors.msg: That guild address is kept for Pawket's own pages.

types.name: Ballot
docs: One wallet's answer to one poll.

types.name: Closet
docs: What an owner has bought in the Market: one bit per item id, for good.

fields.name: spent
docs: Lamports paid into the treasury, in all.

types.name: EventRsvp
docs: One pet going to one event, and whether it came.

types.name: Guestbook
docs: Who waved at a pet: every wave counted, the last eight kept.

types.name: Guild
docs: Fixed-size fields first and the strings last, so every offset but theirs is constant.

fields.name: founder
docs: The wallet that founded it.

fields.name: founder_pet
docs: The pet that founded it.

types.name: GuildEvent
docs: A guild's event. The guild first, so a guild's events are one cheap filter; strings last.

types.name: GuildMember
docs: One pet in one guild. The pet first, then the guild, so either is a cheap filter.

fields.name: payer
docs: Who paid this account's rent, and gets it back when the pet leaves.

types.name: GuildPoll
docs: A guild's poll: up to four options, a count each. The guild first; strings last.

types.name: PawketWallet
docs: A player's Pawket Wallet. Its lamports above rent are the balance.

fields.name: device
docs: The key that may act for the owner, or the default key when no device is linked.

fields.name: device_expires_at
docs: Unix seconds from which the device may no longer act.

fields.name: daily_actions
docs: How many actions the device may take in one UTC day.

fields.name: day
docs: The UTC day `actions_today` counts.

fields.name: actions
docs: Every action a device has taken for this wallet.

fields.name: spent
docs: Lamports moved from the balance onto a device for its fees, less what came back.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: Who paid the rent, and gets it back when the wallet closes.

types.name: Pet
docs: Fixed-size fields first and the name last, so every offset but the name's is constant.

fields.name: last_active_day
docs: UTC day of the last care or round, counted from the epoch. 0 means never.

fields.name: last_play_day
docs: UTC day the daily round bonus was last granted. 0 means never.

fields.name: recent
docs: Ring of the last cares; slot `care_count % 8` is written next. `at == 0` is empty.
